## Childhood Vaccinations

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Vaccination coverage - 1 year
# Data from AIHW Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Performance Framework
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in AIR data
childhood_year1 <- f_read_hpf("302-Immunisation.xlsx",
                              data_sheet    = "D3.02.2",
                              skip_rows     = 2,
                              row_select    = c(8:9),
                              column_select = c(indigenous_status = "x1",
                                                hepb = "hepatitis_b",
                                                "dtp",
                                                "polio",
                                                "hib",
                                                pneumo = "pneumococcal",
                                                fully = "fully_immunised"))

# Data wrangling
childhood_year1 <- childhood_year1 %>% 
  f_wrangle_hpf_vaccination() %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(vaccine = factor(dplyr::recode(vaccine,
                                               "dtp"    = "DTP",
                                               "hepb"   = "Hepatitis B",
                                               "hib"    = "HiB",
                                               "pneumo" = "Pneumococcal",
                                               "polio"  = "Polio",
                                               "fully"  = "Fully immunised"),
                                levels = c("DTP",
                                           "Hepatitis B",
                                           "HiB",
                                           "Pneumococcal",
                                           "Polio",
                                           "Fully immunised"))) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::arrange(vaccine)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Vaccination coverage - 2 years
# Data from AIHW Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Performance Framework
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in AIR data
childhood_year2 <- f_read_hpf("302-Immunisation.xlsx",
                              data_sheet    = "D3.02.3",
                              skip_rows     = 2,
                              row_select    = c(8:9),
                              column_select = c(indigenous_status = "x1",
                                                hepb = "hepatitis_b",
                                                "dtp",
                                                "polio",
                                                "hib",
                                                pneumo = "pneumococcal",
                                                "mmr",
                                                "varicella",
                                                menc = "men_c",
                                                fully = "fully_immunised"))

# Data wrangling
childhood_year2 <- childhood_year2 %>% 
  f_wrangle_hpf_vaccination() %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(vaccine = factor(dplyr::recode(vaccine,
                                               "dtp"       = "DTP",
                                               "hepb"      = "Hepatitis B",
                                               "hib"       = "HiB",
                                               "menc"      = "Men C",
                                               "mmr"       = "MMR",
                                               "pneumo"    = "Pneumococcal",
                                               "polio"     = "Polio",
                                               "varicella" = "Varicella",
                                               "fully"     = "Fully immunised"),
                                levels = c("DTP",
                                           "Hepatitis B",
                                           "HiB",
                                           "Men C",
                                           "MMR",
                                           "Pneumococcal",
                                           "Polio",
                                           "Varicella",
                                           "Fully immunised"))) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::arrange(vaccine)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Vaccination coverage - 5 years
# Data from AIHW Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Performance Framework
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in AIR data
childhood_year5 <- f_read_hpf("302-Immunisation.xlsx",
                              data_sheet    = "D3.02.4",
                              skip_rows     = 2,
                              row_select    = c(8:9),
                              column_select = c(indigenous_status = "x1",
                                                "dtp",
                                                "polio",
                                                fully = "fully_immunised"))

# Data wrangling
childhood_year5 <- childhood_year5 %>% 
  f_wrangle_hpf_vaccination() %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(vaccine = factor(dplyr::recode(vaccine,
                                               "dtp"       = "DTP",
                                               "polio"     = "Polio",
                                               "fully"     = "Fully immunised"),
                                levels = c("DTP",
                                           "Polio",
                                           "Fully immunised"))) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::arrange(vaccine)
```

- Data for this topic were obtained from the [AIHW Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Performance Framework](https://www.indigenoushpf.gov.au/).

- 92% of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander children living in Victoria were fully immunised at 1 year of age, compared to 94% of non-Indigenous children.

- 90% of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander children living in Victoria were fully immunised at 2 years of age, compared to 93% of non-Indigenous children.

- 96% of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander children living in Victoria were fully immunised at 5 years of age, compared to 95% of non-Indigenous children.

::: {.callout-note title="Data notes" icon=false collapse=false}
`r note_data_framework_air`

<div style="height: 1em;"></div>

`r note_caveat_underidentification`

<div style="height: 1em;"></div>

- The aspirational national target for vaccination coverage is for 95% of children to be fully immunised at each age point (1 year, 2 years, and 5 years).
  - The 1 year milestone is assessed for children aged 12-15 months at the time of reporting.
  - The 2 year milestone is assessed for children aged 24-27 months at the time of reporting.
  - The 5 year milestone is assessed for children aged 60-63 months at the time of reporting.

<div style="height: 1em;"></div>

- Children fully immunised for age at 1 year have received all of the following vaccines, due at 6 months of age:
  - [Diphtheria](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/diphtheria), [tetanus](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/tetanus), and [pertussis](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/pertussis-whooping-cough) (DTP)
  - [Hepatitis B](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/hepatitis-b)
  - [Haemophilus influenzae type B](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/haemophilus-influenzae-type-b-hib) (HiB)
  - [Pneumococcal disease](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/pneumococcal-disease)
  - [Poliomyelitis](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/poliomyelitis)
  
<div style="height: 1em;"></div>

- Children fully immunised for age at 2 years have received all of the following vaccines, due at 12 and 18 months of age:
  - [Diphtheria](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/diphtheria), [tetanus](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/tetanus), and [pertussis](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/pertussis-whooping-cough) (DTP)
  - [Hepatitis B](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/hepatitis-b)
  - [Haemophilus influenzae type B](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/haemophilus-influenzae-type-b-hib) (HiB)
  - [Meningococcal C](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/meningococcal-disease) (Men C)
  - [Measles](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/measles), [mumps](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/mumps), and [rubella](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/rubella) (MMR)
  - [Pneumococcal disease](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/pneumococcal-disease)
  - [Poliomyelitis](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/poliomyelitis)
  - [Varicella zoster](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/varicella-chickenpox)

<div style="height: 1em;"></div>

- Children fully immunised for age at 5 years have received all of the following vaccines, due at 48 months of age:
  - [Diphtheria](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/diphtheria), [tetanus](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/tetanus), and [pertussis](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/pertussis-whooping-cough) (DTP)
  - [Poliomyelitis](https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/poliomyelitis)

## Adolescent Vaccination for HPV

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Vaccination coverage - 1 year
# Data from AIHW Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Performance Framework
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in AIR data
adolescent <- f_read_hpf("302-Immunisation.xlsx",
                         data_sheet    = "D3.02.11",
                         skip_rows     = 2,
                         row_select    = 4,
                         column_select = c(girls_indigenous = "girls_2",
                                           boys_indigenous  = "boys_3",
                                           girls_other      = "girls_5",
                                           boys_other       = "boys_6"))

# Data wrangling
adolescent <- adolescent %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>% 
  #
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(),
                      names_to  = "group",
                      values_to = "prop") %>%
  #
  dplyr::mutate(
    sex = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(group, "girls") ~ "Female",
      stringr::str_detect(group, "boys")  ~ "Male"),
    #
    indigenous_label = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(group, "indigenous") ~ "Aboriginal",
      stringr::str_detect(group, "other")      ~ "Non-Indigenous",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    #
    indigenous_status = factor(dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(group, "indigenous") ~ "Identified as Aboriginal\nand/or Torres Strait Islander",
      stringr::str_detect(group, "other")      ~ "Did not identify as Aboriginal\nand/or Torres Strait Islander",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
      #
      levels = c("Identified as Aboriginal\nand/or Torres Strait Islander",
                 "Did not identify as Aboriginal\nand/or Torres Strait Islander"))) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::select(sex,
                indigenous_status,
                indigenous_label,
                prop)
```

- Data for this topic were obtained from the [AIHW Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Performance Framework](https://www.indigenoushpf.gov.au/).

- 83% of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander adolescent females living in Victoria had received at least one HPV vaccine dose before their 15th birthday, compared to 87% of non-Indigenous adolescent females.

- 79% of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander adolescent males living in Victoria had received at least one HPV vaccine dose before their 15th birthday, compared to 84% of non-Indigenous adolescent males.

## Adult Vaccinations

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Adult vaccinations - influenza
# Data from ABS National Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Survey
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in NATSIHS data
adult_influenza <- f_read_natsihs_sex("Indicator_Vic_Sex_Vaccination_Influenza.csv")

# Data wrangling
adult_influenza <- adult_influenza %>% 
  dplyr::rowwise() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(answered_n = sum(across(never_had_influenza_vaccination_n:had_influenza_vaccination_in_last_12_months_n))) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  #
  janitor::adorn_totals(fill = "Total") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename(never_n     = never_had_influenza_vaccination_n,
                notrecent_n = had_influenza_vaccination_but_not_in_last_12_months_n,
                recent_n    = had_influenza_vaccination_in_last_12_months_n) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(across(never_n:recent_n,
                       ~ . / answered_n * 100,
                       .names = "{.col}_prop"),
                #
                answered_prop = answered_n / answered_n * 100) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename_with(~ stringr::str_replace(., "_n_prop$", "_prop"), ends_with("_n_prop")) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::select(sex,
                starts_with("recent"),
                starts_with("notrecent"),
                starts_with("never"),
                starts_with("answered")) %>% 
  #
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!sex,
                      names_to = c("answer", ".value"),
                      names_pattern = "(.+)_(.+)") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(answer = factor(dplyr::recode(answer,
                                              "recent"    = "Within last 12 months",
                                              "notrecent" = "More than 12 months ago",
                                              "never"     = "Never",
                                              "answered"  = "Total"),
                                levels = c("Within last 12 months",
                                           "More than 12 months ago",
                                           "Never",
                                           "Total")))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Adult vaccinations - pneumococcal disease
# Data from ABS National Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Survey
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in NATSIHS data
adult_pneumo <- f_read_natsihs_sex("Indicator_Vic_Sex_Vaccination_Pneumococcal.csv")

# Data wrangling
adult_pneumo <- adult_pneumo %>% 
  dplyr::rowwise() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(answered_n = sum(across(never_had_pneumococcus_vaccination_n:had_pneumococcus_vaccination_in_last_5_years_n))) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  #
  janitor::adorn_totals(fill = "Total") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename(never_n     = never_had_pneumococcus_vaccination_n,
                notrecent_n = had_pneumococcus_vaccination_but_not_in_last_5_years_n,
                recent_n    = had_pneumococcus_vaccination_in_last_5_years_n) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(across(never_n:recent_n,
                       ~ . / answered_n * 100,
                       .names = "{.col}_prop"),
                #
                answered_prop = answered_n / answered_n * 100) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename_with(~ stringr::str_replace(., "_n_prop$", "_prop"), ends_with("_n_prop")) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::select(sex,
                starts_with("recent"),
                starts_with("notrecent"),
                starts_with("never"),
                starts_with("answered")) %>% 
  #
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!sex,
                      names_to = c("answer", ".value"),
                      names_pattern = "(.+)_(.+)") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(answer = factor(dplyr::recode(answer,
                                              "recent"    = "Within last 5 years",
                                              "notrecent" = "More than 5 years ago",
                                              "never"     = "Never",
                                              "answered"  = "Total"),
                                levels = c("Within last 5 years",
                                           "More than 5 years ago",
                                           "Never",
                                           "Total")))
```

- Data for this topic were obtained from the [2022-23 ABS National Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Survey](https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/people/aboriginal-and-torres-strait-islander-peoples/national-aboriginal-and-torres-strait-islander-health-survey/latest-release).

- Overall, 39% (approximately 11,400 people) of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander survey respondents aged 15 years and over living in Greater Melbourne had received an influenza vaccine in the 12 months prior to the survey, and a further 45% (approximately 13,000 people) had received an influenza vaccine more than 12 months ago.

- Females were more likely to have received an influenza vaccine in the last 12 months than males (42% vs. 37%).

- Overall, 12% (approximately 3,100 people) of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander survey respondents aged 15 years and over living in Greater Melbourne had received a pneumococcal vaccine in the 5 years prior to the survey, and a further 5.2% (approximately 1,400 people) had received a pneumococcal vaccine more than 5 years ago.

- Males were more likely to have received a pneumococcal vaccine in the last 5 years than females (17% vs. 5.5%).

#

  f_bar_grouped_sex(x_variable = answer,

figure_percent <- adult_influenza %>%

#### Table 9F-5

:::

```{r}
#
table_count  <- table_count + 1
table_number <- paste0("Table_", table_section, "_", sprintf("%.02d", table_count))

table <- adult_influenza %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from  = "sex",
                     values_from = c("n", "prop"),
                     names_vary  = "slowest") %>% 
  #
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename(influenza_vaccine = answer)

if (!file.exists(paste0(here::here(), "/data/", table_number, ".csv"))) {
  
  write.csv(table, paste0(here::here(), "/data/", table_number, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
}

table %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(prop_male   = sprintf("%.1f", prop_male),
                prop_female = sprintf("%.1f", prop_female),
                prop_total  = sprintf("%.1f", prop_total)) %>%
  #
  f_table_grouped_sex(n_variable  = "estimate",
                      column_name = "Influenza vaccine")
```
